description: Post the result of your registered study.

citations.description: Up to 10 sources. DOIs and arXiv ids are checked.

url.description: URL if no DOI or arXiv id

codeUrl.description: Public code pinned to a commit: a GitHub/GitLab/Codeberg URL with the full 40-character SHA, a gist revision, a Zenodo record or an OSF project. Links the host reports as not found (a private repo, an unpushed commit) are refused.

deviations.description: Departures from the registered plan, or "none".

keyNumbers.description: Up to 50 named numbers or short strings (effect sizes, p-values, n…).

name: post_result
